summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (PrS 59/18)

data.turoyo: U dewo məlle lu dewo kafino, omər: "Qṭaʕ bam maye, tox l gabayna, aḥna ġarəqina."
data.translation: ein anderer vom jenseitigen Ufer zu: "Geh durch's Wasser und komm zu uns, wir leben hier im Ueberfluss."

rationale: Thin I Preterit Intransitive cell (2 existing); plural abundance-state ġarəqina has no overt b- complement and makes the inherited Überfluss haben gloss concrete.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (90/105)

data.turoyo: Ḥəlle, hano, u=dayroyo, ġarəq b i=ḥṭiṯo, lakən haw knəfqo b iḏe.
data.translation: Der Schmied schaute: der Mönch ist in Sünde versunken, aber er kann nichts machen.

rationale: Thin I Preterit Intransitive cell: explicit sin-domain b-complement and a fully named subject supply a clear figurative context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (113/188)

data.turoyo: lo ġariqat bi ḥultəke? Qay əmmatwa, lo moṭatla?
data.translation: bist du nicht froh über das Tantchen? Warum sagtest du, ich solle es nicht hereinbringen?

rationale: Completes the I Preterit Intransitive cell to five and supplies the previously unillustrated froh sein über component of sense 1.

data.turoyo: Omər: “Ḥur, abuna!” Omər: “Lo=ġərqat b i=ḥṭiṯo ha!
data.translation: "Sieh, Vater! Verstricke dich nicht in Sünde!

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: a negative directive with b i=ḥṭiṯo illustrates the inherited figurative meaning; lo plus Infectum is not an Imperativ form.

data.turoyo: Komər: "Hn, ḥaru bayto, ḥaru bayto, e, lo ġariqat bi ḥultəke? Qay əmmatwa, lo moṭatla?" — "E", — kəmmo, — "ṭrowe, ṭro ġərqono eba."
data.translation: Da sprach er: Hm! Ei zum Kuckuck, bist du nicht froh über das Tantchen? Warum sagtest du, ich solle es nicht hereinbringen? - Nun gut, laß mich froh über es sein!

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: ṭro governs first-person feminine ġərqono, contrasting with the state predicate in the same exchange. Retain the aunt antecedent.

data.turoyo: “Aydarbo ono maġraqli ruḥi b i=ḥṭiṯo w mbeli ruḥi l u=halak w ḏəmli u=ḥadodano?
data.translation: "wie konnte ich mich in der Sünde untergehen lassen, mich ins Verderben stürzen und geringschätzig von diesem Schmiede reden!

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell (1 existing): active causation with explicit ruḥi contrasts with the suffix patient of the inherited example.

summary: Keep the broad inherited I.1 unchanged: sinking, sin-entanglement, abundance and pleasure are explicitly present in its gloss. The new texts illustrate existing components rather than proposing new numbered meanings.

The Experiencer is the subject in the pleasure reading; b- marks the human stimulus (bi ḥultəke / eba). In sin contexts b- marks an abstract domain; in physical sinking it marks a medium. These semantic roles should not be collapsed into a single causal interpretation.
Preterit Intransitive forms can describe present abundance or satisfaction. ṭro plus Infectum expresses a desired state; edition tense alone is not a form label.

III maġraqli ruḥi is active reflexive causation, while maġráqluxli has a distinct affected participant. The m-prefixed kməġroqo at 57/55 is the inherited Detransitive sinking form and is already quoted.
The road label b du ġariq occurs twice, but its finite versus nominal/adjectival status cannot be determined from the supplied passages. Neither occurrence is used to populate a form box.
At 57/47 and 57/51 is ġariq a nominal/adjectival loan predicate or a substantivized Preterit Intransitive clause? Both form analyses have been withheld.

The current I Detransitive section has an Infectum example but no numbered sense or base-form line. Should the editors make its implicit “versinken, untergehen” sense explicit? No unsupported paradigm or numbering is supplied here.
